### Graeme Styles

#### Senior Insurance, FS & Engineering Recruitment Consultant

**Role Overview**

Our Client is a personal lines specialist motor broker based in Twickenham. who focus exclusively on providing tailored motor insurance solutions to personal lines clients, and are looking for a diligent and empathetic Complaints Handler to join our Complaints & Quality Control team.

This is a customer-focused role at the heart of how we put things right. You will take ownership of customer complaints from first notification through to final resolution, investigating each case thoroughly, communicating clearly and fairly with customers, and ensuring every complaint is handled in line with FCA rules and our own internal standards. You will work closely with the wider Complaints & Quality Control team, as well as underwriting, claims, and customer service colleagues, to identify root causes and help drive improvements across the business.
